writeup: Woot has the new Bakken black 12.5-quart ceramic nonstick stockpot (model BKCRSTKPTBL312KK, UPC 850077244476) for $44.99. It has a PTFE and PFAS-free ceramic coating, works on induction, and is oven safe to 500°F, with an aluminum alloy body, a 0.1-inch base, and a glass lid. Bakken's own store lists the matching 12.5-quart black pot at $79.99 and shows it in stock with free shipping. Kohl's has the same Bakken 12.5-quart ceramic stockpot in black at $107.99, also in stock. That is 43 percent below the lowest verified store price and saves about $35. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of ten per customer.
